NOTICE FOR MEETING UNDER THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES (AMENDMENT) ACT, NO. 22 OF 2012

I, Mariyathas Patrick Diranjan, Commissioner of Local Government, Northern Province by virtue powers vested to meunder Sub Section No. 66(C) of Local Authorities Elections (Amendment) Act, No. 22 of 2012, hereby notify to convenethe first meeting for the election of Mayor/Chairman, Deputy Mayor/Vice Chairman for the Local Authorities in NorthernProvince Scheduled below according to the date, time and venue specified below.
M. PATRICK DIRANJAN,Commissioner of Local Government,
Northern Province.
Department of Local Government,Northern Province,Elders Home Complex,A9 Road, Kaithdy,Jaffna,15th March 2018.
